استغرقوا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْرَقُوا (istaḡraqū) /is.taɣ.ra.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# اُسْتُغْرِقُوا (ustuḡriqū) /us.tuɣ.ri.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# اِسْتَغْرِقُوا (istaḡriqū) /is.taɣ.ri.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
